newsitem.title: CHINA: China 1996 electric appliance exports up 18.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: China 1996 electric appliance exports up 18.5 pct.

text.p: China exported $2.75 billion worth of household electric appliances in 1996, up 18.5 percent from 1995 on market expansion, Business News said on Thursday.

In 1996, China exported 558,000 washing machines worth $58.57 million, 1.03 million refrigerators worth $78.15 million and 474,000 airconditioners worth $158 million, up 37.4 percent, 32 percent and 18 percent respectively from 1995, it said.
Electric fans were China's biggest export item on volume of 67 million units worth $650 million in 1996, the newspaper said.
Increased exports to South America and Southeast Asia were mostly responsible for the increased overall volume, it said.

Chinese electric appliance producers, such as Qingdao Haier Refrigerator Co and Wuxi Little Swan, have begun to set up factories in Indonesia and Malaysia, the newspaper said but gave no further details.
